posts.text: /loop 5m make sure this PR passes CI. While loops for agents have dropped!
posts.notes: /loop command: persistent agent while-loops with configurable interval. Example: /loop 5m make sure PR passes CI. 226K views, 732 bookmarks. Critical feature for autonomous CI/CD agent workflows without human polling.

posts.text: Remote Control - Session Spawning: Run claude remote-control and then spawn a NEW local session in the mobile app. * Out to Max, Team, and Enterprise (>=2.1.74) *Have GH set up on mobile (relaxing soon) * Working on speeding up session start-time
posts.notes: Remote Control expansion: spawn NEW local sessions from mobile app. Available to Max/Team/Enterprise (>=2.1.74). 732K views, 1,512 bookmarks. Roadmap item: speed up session start-time. Important for async remote agent control.

posts.text: You can now schedule recurring cloud-based tasks on Claude Code. Set a repo (or repos), a schedule, and a prompt. Claude runs it via cloud infra on your schedule, so you don't need to keep Claude Code running on your local machine.
posts.notes: HIGHEST SIGNAL. Cloud-based recurring task scheduling for Claude Code. No local machine needed — cloud infra executes. 1.99M views, 5,907 bookmarks. Critical signal: Claude Code evolving from local coding tool to cloud-native autonomous agent infrastructure. Directly relevant to L-Thread scheduled automation.

posts.text: Loops now run for up to 7 days instead of 3. Let me know what you're /looping on!
posts.notes: Loop duration extended: 3 days → 7 days. Signals Anthropic confidence in autonomous long-running agent workflows. 96K views.

posts.text: Use /schedule to create recurring cloud-based jobs for Claude, directly from the terminal. We use these internally to automatically resolve CI failures, push doc updates, and generally power automations that you want to exist beyond a closed laptop
posts.notes: /schedule command for cloud-based recurring jobs. Anthropic internal use cases: auto-resolve CI failures, push doc updates. 977K views, 3,056 bookmarks. Validates cloud-native agent automation as the direction of Claude Code.

posts.text: Thrilled to announce Claude Code auto-fix – in the cloud. Web/Mobile sessions can now automatically follow PRs - fixing CI failures and addressing comments so that your PR is always green. This happens remotely so you can fully walk away and come back to a ready-to-go PR.
posts.notes: Claude Code auto-fix in cloud: web/mobile sessions autonomously fix CI failures + address PR comments. Walk away and come back to green PR. 1.32M views, 2,934 bookmarks. LATEST POST (Mar 26). Validates fully autonomous code shipping agent loop.
